source.scope: Shared metamagic apparatus game rules in the already approved item snapshot; exclude editorial pricing discussion, advertisements and artwork.

shared.activation: part of casting the sphere effect
shared.handling: Hold in at least one hand or wear as appropriate to the selected form.
shared.form: Held slender rod, a source-permitted appearance; no weapon attack or armor properties are implied.
shared.combinationException: An apparatus applying multiple metamagic feats at once divides normal daily uses and cost by three, rounding uses up. Multiple talents combined by one metamagic feat are not automatically multiple feats.

cascading-metamagic-apparatus.requirements: Only self-targeted effects of at least one round, persisting without concentration. Each talent CL <=7; sum CL <=9. Use shortest duration and longest casting time.

reaching-metamagic-apparatus.requirements: Each activation advances one range category along touch, close, medium, long. Repeat activations may use the same apparatus during one casting; no other apparatus is added.

extending-metamagic-apparatus.additionalTiming: when spending a spell point to make a concentrated effect persist without concentration
extending-metamagic-apparatus.requirements: Double duration except concentration, instantaneous or permanent. The later persistence option is an alternative to applying it at initial casting.

fleeting-metamagic-apparatus.additionalTiming: when spending a spell point to make a concentrated effect persist without concentration
fleeting-metamagic-apparatus.requirements: At least two rounds; no instantaneous/permanent effects. Halve duration, excluding concentration time; Extend cancels the duration adjustment. Swift dismissal leaves a concealed aura; countering is easier and removes an active fleeting effect without a check.

flaring-metamagic-apparatus.requirements: Preserve the light descriptor versus fire/electricity damage-trigger inconsistency and malformed duration wording. Do not supply an invented damage trigger or duration formula.

still-metamagic-apparatus.requirements: Activate mentally while carried or worn; no holding or wielding required. Remove only the selected talent's somatic component, if it has one.

suppressed-metamagic-apparatus.requirements: Published three-pound weight. Reduced manifestation uses Perception DC 15 + half caster level, with optional +2 per relevant sensory talent; suppressing a required sensation cannot preserve an effect that relies on it.
